title: AccountNukedPayload
description: Phase 3 (memory.md §5.3). Produced by the Orchestrator's Account Pool Manager after aws-nuke + the mandatory verification pass. verified:true means the account returned to AVAILABLE; verified:false routes to ACCOUNT_QUARANTINED instead.

verified.description: true iff post-nuke enumeration (Config + Resource Explorer + blind-spot list) found zero resources

resources_remaining.description: count found by the verification pass; must be 0 for verified:true
